prompt: A record is only as immutable as its components: make TeamRoster defensively copy, clean and freeze the member list in its compact constructor, and add a wither that returns a new roster.
explanation: A record's fields are final, but a final reference to an ArrayList still points at a list anyone can mutate, so real immutability needs a defensive copy plus Collections.unmodifiableList in the compact constructor. Doing the cleaning there also means every roster is canonical -- same members always give the same sorted list -- so the generated equals works no matter what order the caller supplied. withMember is the record idiom for updates: build a new list, hand it to the constructor and return a brand-new value instead of mutating this one.
hints: Validate and trim the name first; assigning to the parameter inside a compact constructor is what stores the cleaned value.
Build a fresh ArrayList, skip nulls and blanks, trim each entry, use cleaned.contains(trimmed) to drop duplicates, Collections.sort it, then assign Collections.unmodifiableList(cleaned) to members.
withMember can copy members into a new ArrayList, add the new name and call new TeamRoster(name, longer) -- the constructor does the trimming, de-duplicating and sorting again.
